City of Encinitas
Regular City Council Meeting - 6:00 p.m.
AGENDA
WEDNESDAY, SEPTEMBER 29, 2021 -
6:00
p.m.
City of Encinitas - City Council Chambers
505 S. Vulcan Avenue
Encinitas, California 92024
Each speaker is allowed three (3) minutes to address the City Council.
1.
CALL TO ORDER
2.
ROLL CALL
3.
PLEDGE OF ALLEGIANCE
4.
SPECIAL PRESENTATIONS AND PROCLAMATIONS
4A.
Presentation by John McNair, JC Resorts, regarding the Encinitas Ranch Golf Authority (ERGA) Financial Results for FY 2020-21
4B.
Presentation by SEJPA GM Michael Thorton on the Planned Bike Path at the San Elijo Water Campus
5.
ORAL COMMUNICATIONS / POSSIBLE DIRECTION TO STAFF (30 MINUTES)
Oral Communications will be accepted as outlined above under New Public Comment Procedures. Each speaker is allowed three (3) minutes to address the City Council. Oral Communication items will be referred to the City Manager either for resolution by administrative action or placement on a future agenda.
2021-09-29 Item 05 Oral Communications Received by 3PM
6.
REPORT FROM CLOSED SESSION (IF HELD)
7.
CHANGES TO THE AGENDA Announcements of administrative changes to the agenda, in compliance with the Brown Act.
The title of ordinances listed on this agenda are deemed to have been read and further reading waived.
8.
CONSENT CALENDAR The recommendations on the following Consent Calendar will be enacted in one motion unless an item is removed from the Calendar. Public Comments will be accepted as outlined above under New Public Comment Procedures. Each speaker is allowed three (3) minutes to address the City Council. Items removed from the Consent Calendar by a Council Member or the public will be considered immediately following the Consent Calendar.
*If a public hearing item is part of the consent calendar, the public hearing shall be deemed held if the item is not removed from the consent calendar for discussion and possible action.
8A.
Approval of the Minutes of the September 15, 2021 Special City Council Closed Session Meeting. Contact Person: City Clerk Hollywood
Approve the Minutes.
2021-09-29 Item 08A Minutes
8B.
Approval of the Warrants List (Register of Demands). Contact Person: Finance Manager Sanderson
Staff recommends that the City Council review and approve the warrants.
2021-09-29 Item 08B Approval of Warrants List
8C.
Appointment to the Traffic and Public Safety Commission – At Large Representative to fill one unscheduled vacancy with a term ending March 1, 2022. Contact Person: City Clerk Hollywood
The City Council approve the Mayor’s recommendation to appoint June Honsberger to fill the unscheduled vacancy on the Traffic and Public Safety Commission – At Large Representative with a term ending March 1, 2022.
2021-09-29 Item 08C Appointment to TPS - Unscheduled Vacancy - Redacted
2021-09-29 Item 08C Public Comments Received by 3PM
8D.
Amendment #2 to the Memorandum of Understanding and License Agreement (“MOU”) with the North County Transit District (“NCTD”) allowing use of NCTD owned Right-of-Way (“ROW”) for temporary public parking and various improvements for Leucadia Streetscape. Contact Person: Director of Infrastructure and Sustainability Doherty
Authorize the City Manager to execute Amendment #2 to the MOU with NCTD in substantial form as Attachment 1 of the agenda report, in consultation with the City Attorney, to provide clarity on the type of rail corridor fencing to be constructed and who is responsible to fund design and construction of different segments of fencing.
2021-09-29 Item 08D 2nd Amendment to MOU with NCTD - Fencing
8E.
Legislative position letters submitted to Council for ratification. Contact Person: Senior Management Analyst Piatt
Ratify the position letters in support of AB 43 (Friedman) (Attachment 1 of the agenda report), and in support of AB 361 (Rivas) (Attachment 2 of the agenda report).
2021-09-29 Item 08E Legislative Position Letters for Ratification
8F.
Professional services agreement for professional planning services to support planning application processing, building/grading permit plan check processing and other planning functions. Contact Person: Principal Planner Innes
Authorize the City Manager to enter into an agreement with Civic Solutions, Inc., for a not-to-exceed agreement amount of $640,000, for 21 months, with an option to renew (upon the execution of a written extension agreement), for another three (3) one-year terms based on workload needs and available budget for a total not-to-exceed agreement amount of $1,670,131 (Attachment 1 of the agenda report).
2021-09-29 Item 08F Professional Planning Consulting Services - Agreement Amended 0414 PM 0923
8G.
Memorandum of Understanding with North County Transit District for Collaboration on a Safe Rail Corridor Study. Contact Person: Director of Infrastructure and Sustainability Doherty
Authorize the City Manager, in consultation with the City Attorney, to execute the Memorandum of Understanding (“MOU”) with North County Transit District (“NCTD”), in substantial form as provide in Attachment 1 of the agenda report, to engage in collaboration in the development of safe rail corridor recommendations for the California Public Utilities Commission (“CPUC”) consideration.
2021-09-29 Item 08G MOU NCTD Collaboration on Safe Rail Corridor Study
2021-09-29 Item 08G Public Comments Received by 3PM
9.
ITEMS REMOVED FROM THE CONSENT CALENDAR Staff reports will be given only if requested by the person who pulled the item.
10.
ACTION ITEMS Public Comments will be accepted as outlined above under New Public Comment Procedures. Each speaker is allowed three (3) minutes to address the City Council.
10A.
Request to Locate the Safe Parking Lot at the Encinitas Community and Senior Center at 1140 Oakcrest Park Drive operated by Jewish Family Service (JFS) for a maximum of 25 vehicles accommodating households living in their cars and public hearing to consider Ordinance No. 2021-09 to create reasonable local standards and procedures for operation of a safe parking lot in accordance with Government Code Section 8698 Shelter Crisis. Contact Persons: Housing Services Manager Gutierrez and Planning Manager Gates
1) Consider request by Jewish Family Service to operate a Safe Parking Program at the Encinitas Community & Senior Center (Community and Senior Center) located at 1140 Oakcrest Park Drive and provide direction to staff on whether to create a Use Agreement; and 2) If City Council directs staff to move forward with the Use Agreement, introduce Ordinance No. 2021-09 titled "Ordinance of the City Council of the City of Encinitas Establishing Reasonable Local Standards and Procedures for Operation of a Safe Parking Lot in Accordance with Government Code Section 8698 Shelter Crisis" (Attachment 1 of the agenda report).

CITY COUNCIL MEMBER REPORTS PURSUANT TO AB1234 (GC 53232.3(d)) / POSSIBLE DIRECTION TO STAFF
Notice to the Public:
To ensure that the City meets your needs when addressing the City Council, all presentation materials which require the use of visual equipment need to be submitted to the City's IT Division at least 24 hours in advance of the meeting (except for appeal hearings where materials must be submitted 7 days in advance). This includes photographs, Microsoft Office documents (PowerPoint, Word, Excel). No CD's, DVD's, or USB thumb/flash drives will be accepted at the meeting. All materials must be in PC format and digital presentation items must be emailed to it-service-desk@encinitasca.gov . Please label all materials with the corresponding agenda item number. Should technical assistance be necessary, it will be available to presenters from 5:30 p.m. to 5:50 p.m. on the day of the meeting. Presentation of video/digital/photographs are considered part of the maximum time limit provided to speakers.
